events.title: Endless Bounce v0.16.6
events.summary: Twins are finally telling themselves apart The badges on the table are gone - instead the tooltip tells you which pair and which role a twin has. It takes you through ten stages up to the first boss – with the full game around it: shop, talent tree, combining, every kind of bumper. What you get Pinball, but you build the table. Between stages you buy bumpers and place them wherever the ball will hit them. Combining. Two bumpers merge into a stronger one – knowing the recipes gets you further. events.title: Bigger type, finally easy to read
events.summary: New typeface, much easier to read The whole game now uses a single typeface – Jersey 10 – and it is noticeably larger than before. Shop descriptions, talent texts and tooltips are far easier to read on the Steam Deck and from the couch. Other changes The blank perk shows up more often in the shop. It was so rare that you could go through long runs without ever seeing it – it now appears regularly, while still being rarer than the strong multipliers. events.title: Hotfix v0.16.3: Talent points during a run
events.summary: Talent points can be spent during a run again Too much was locked. The intent was only that you cannot refund talents in the middle of a tough stage to rebuild yourself out of trouble. Spending points works everywhere again and takes effect immediately - the one exception is the start bumper, which is already on the table and only changes with your next run. events.title: Hotfix v0.16.2: Leaderboard and crash fixed
events.summary: Two bugs from yesterday's update, both fixed. No new content. The leaderboard stayed empty The list showed nothing at all, or shrank to your own entry after a moment. Two causes behind it: the query for "You are in the top X%" ran at the same time as the list and intercepted its answer - and the display kept no copy of its own data, so the following query overwrote it. Nothing was ever missing on the server. Your entries were there the whole time, they just never reached you. Rocket boost crash

events.title: Update v0.16.1: Controller and Accessibility
events.summary: Full controller support Menus, talent tree, inventory and shop can now be operated entirely with a controller. The d-pad hops from field to field, the stick lets you aim freely on the table, and the moment you reach for the mouse your usual cursor is back. Colorblind mode The settings now let you choose between green-, red- and blue-weak vision. A screen filter remaps the colors, and every multi-tier bumper additionally carries its tier number.
